stories.title: Police appeal to find man who missed Chester Crown Court sentencing

stories.title: Saltney school closures: formal objection period opens until 1 December
stories.summary: People who want to object to plans to close Saltney Ferry and Saltney Wood Memorial primary schools have until 1 December to do so. Flintshire County Council published its statutory notice on the plans on 3 November, which opens a 28-day objection period. stories.title: Planned power cut for properties around Oakenholt Lane near Connah’s Quay
stories.summary: Properties around Oakenholt Lane, near Connah’s Quay, are without power today while SP Energy Networks carries out planned work on the network. stories.title: Labour backs Plaid budget four months after summer defeat
stories.summary: The Senedd has approved the Welsh Government’s revised spending plans for this year, nearly four months after the first version was voted down. MSs backed the £354 million second supplementary budget for 2026-27 by 54 votes to 39 on Tuesday night. There were no abstentions. The minority Plaid Cymru government got the votes it needed
